_about: PT11a golden set for rweToRw: readings taken DIRECTLY off the Schlumberger Rw versus Rweq chart (SP-2 in current Log Interpretation Charts editions, Gen-9 in older ones), never off another implementation. Each point: rwe and rw in ohm.m, temp_f in degF, precision as a relative fraction of Rw the chart grid allows (assigned here from the grid: 3 percent on the fresh columns, 5 percent on the saline corner where the 75 F curve is nearly vertical; the calibration check below recovered the printed example to 0.25 percent, so grid reading, not scan geometry, sets it). The jest gate (petrophysics.rw.test.js gate 2) brackets every ACCEPTED point to its precision and requires every point OUTSIDE the engine's accepted band to be refused; it reports PENDING while no reading falls inside the band.
citation: Schlumberger Log Interpretation Charts, chart SP-2 (Rw versus Rweq and formation temperature), scanned reproduction; Bateman & Konen 1977, The Log Analyst 18(5) p. 3-11 for the fit under test.
needs_human_check: RESOLVED 2026-09-10: 75 F between Rweq 0.02 and 0.06 read label-anchored (five inband points). A first trace from the chart's printed example landed on a hot curve (Rw 0.025/0.0345/0.041/0.0525/0.063 at the same Rweq, matching the fit at 300 to 500 F within 4 percent) and was discarded because it was non-monotonic with the saline set and below the 75 F saturation asymptote; the example's printed 75 F is its Rmf temperature.
NEXT: the same Rweq 0.02 to 0.06 column at 150 F and 300 F, to test the fit's temperature handling inside the band (only 75 F is confirmed).
verdict_2026_09_10: The Bateman-Konen fit does not reproduce the chart outside a saline band: 36 to 92 percent LOW on all 28 fresh readings (Rw 1.0 to 5.0 ohm.m, all seven temperatures) and 13 to 24 percent HIGH on the three saline 75 F readings (Rweq 0.0075 to 0.015). Every chart reading has Rw above Rweq; the fit turns the correction downward between Rwe 0.1 and about 1.4 ohm.m below 250 F. Inside the accepted band (rweMin75F 0.02 Arps to formation T .. rweMax 0.1 at formation T, RWE_TO_RW_DOMAIN) the five label-anchored 75 F readings put the fit within 10 percent (+9.3 to -4.2), so it is accepted there with that residual declared; other temperatures inside the band are unread.

fit_residual_note: Inside the accepted band the gate asks the fit to sit within fit_residual_accepted of each chart reading, NOT within reading precision: the Bateman-Konen fit is a 1977 pocket-calculator approximation and the 75 F readings show it +9.3 percent at Rweq 0.020, +5.9 at 0.030, +3.1 at 0.038, -1.6 at 0.050, -4.2 at 0.060 (the uncorrected Rweq would be 23 to 57 percent low). The same 10 percent standard gates rwFromSalinity against Gen-9 (PT9d). The band floor rweMin75F = 0.02 is where the residual crosses 10 percent; below 0.015 it is 13 to 24 percent. The residual is declared in RWE_TO_RW_DOMAIN.fitResidual and stated in the Studio.
